## R packages

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.tool-card}
[On CRAN]{.status .ok}

### ERA5Flux
Improves the usefulness of ERA5-Land reanalysis at AmeriFlux sites. It downloads ERA5-Land for site locations, formats and merges it with tower data, and blends the two into a gap-filled time series.

```r
install.packages("ERA5Flux")
```

[Documentation](https://malone-disturbance-ecology-lab.github.io/ERA5Flux/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/ERA5Flux)
:::

::: {.tool-card}
[Development version]{.status}

### CarbonExchangeParameters
Carbon flux partitioning: fits light response curves to daytime NEE and temperature response curves to nighttime NEE, with Bayesian models (brms and Stan).

```r
install.packages("CarbonExchangeParameters",
  repos = c("https://malone-disturbance-ecology-lab.r-universe.dev",
            "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
# or: remotes::install_github("Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/CarbonExchangeParameters")
```

[Documentation](https://malone-disturbance-ecology-lab.github.io/CarbonExchangeParameters/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/CarbonExchangeParameters)
:::

:::

All lab packages are also built on [R-universe](https://malone-disturbance-ecology-lab.r-universe.dev). Both are MIT licensed.

## Code and teaching

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.tool-card}
### RustMapper
Code behind the white pine blister rust risk maps. Data: [1980-2023](products/rustmapper-historical.qmd) and [2030-2099](products/rustmapper-projections.qmd). [Open the app](apps.qmd#rustmapper).

[GitHub](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/RUSTMapper)
:::

::: {.tool-card}
### Everglades fire history
Code used to build [Fire in the Everglades](products/everglades-fire-history.qmd) and the fire perimeter records.

[GitHub](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/Everglades-Fire-History)
:::

::: {.tool-card}
### Everglades salinity models
Models of salinity across Everglades National Park from monitoring and Landsat data, used with the [salinity and carbon dataset](products/everglades-salinity-carbon.qmd).

[ENP_Salinity_Model](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/ENP_Salinity_Model) · [ENP_Landsat_Salinity_Model](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/ENP_Landsat_Salinity_Model)
:::

::: {.tool-card}
### Environmental Data Science in R (ENV 730)
Course data for integrating environmental data and machine learning in R, Yale School of the Environment.

[Course data on EDI](https://portal.edirepository.org/nis/mapbrowse?scope=edi&identifier=2081&revision=1)
:::

::: {.tool-card}
### Thermal response strength script
R script that calculates the thermal response strength of ecosystem respiration, distributed with the [thermal acclimation dataset](products/respiration-thermal-acclimation.qmd).
:::

:::

More code is on the lab's [GitHub organization](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab).
